_comment: Tracked record of what the 2026-07-30 Airtable cutover actually did to the
live base. The tool writes its receipt into run_state/, which is gitignored
because backup.json beside it holds real lead notes and phone numbers. This
copy carries counts, IDs and hashes only — no lead data — so the repo's
account of the base survives a machine loss. See

snapshots.backup_covers: the 23 retired fields plus Place Key and Consent Posture

API call can perform it — not because it was skipped. See
completed_by_hand_2026-07-30.stray_tasks_link_field_deleted: Airtable degraded the Prospects Tasks link field to singleLineText when the table was deleted; removed as well

final_verification_2026-07-30.upload_airtable_dry_run: exit 0; ICP Lane and Opportunity Score present; no retired field in any payload
final_verification_2026-07-30.call_queue_matches_query_ready_to_send: identical record set, not merely the same count
final_verification_2026-07-30.not_verified: Per-view hidden/shown field configuration. The REST API returns all populated fields regardless of a view's visibility settings, so field visibility cannot be asserted from outside the UI.

_comment: An earlier version of docs/airtable_schema_required.md asserted that the
Meta API refuses to add choices to an existing select, on no recorded
evidence; a later version marked the claim unverified. This is the
recorded result. Re-run the two calls below before believing otherwise.
api_capability_probe_2026-07-30.patch_field_description: 200 — endpoint, PAT scope and field are all fine; restored to the original value, also 200
body_shapes_tried: existing choices echoed verbatim (id + name + color), new choices name-only
api_capability_probe_2026-07-30.conclusion: Airtable's Update Field API does not modify an existing single-select's choices. POST .../fields can create a new field with choices (that is how ICP Lane was created the same day); update cannot, and there is no delete endpoint at all. Creating the missing choices is a hand step.

verification_commands.required_select_choices_expected: exit 0 — the base offers every choice the code writes
verification_commands.field_deletion_expected: exit 0 — the 23 retired fields are gone and the record count is unchanged
verification_commands._comment: Both are ongoing drift checks, not one-shot gates. Re-run either after any base edit; a non-zero exit means the base has fallen behind the code again.

known_risks: backup.json does not contain Notes. The 16 records whose misplaced Sales — Batch call notes were migrated now hold exactly the migration string in Notes. If any of them carried prior hand-typed notes, those are unrecoverable. No code path writes Notes, so prior content would have been typed by hand.
RESOLVED by the field deletion: the 13 fields dropped from upload_airtable.py's write path no longer exist, so no stale value can be read as current.
